text:
Priya Patel: Handoff - I'm primary for the 01:00-09:00 UTC shift starting now. Secondary is Sam O'Neill. Leaving a few notes: region-eu pool has been flappy last 24h, watch tail latency on /generate. If you get pages, follow pg-connection-spike runbook. I will be reachable for first 30m then in a brief meeting (back at 05:00 UTC).

oncall-bot: Rotation reminder: primary=Priya Patel, secondary=Sam O'Neill. Escalation: eng-oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-leads. See /schedules/rotation for details.

Sam O'Neill: Ack. I'll monitor alerts on my phone. Quick Q: who is after my slot at 09:00 UTC? Michael or Jorge?

Priya Patel: Michael Chen is scheduled 09:00-17:00 UTC. FYI Jorge is OOO later tonight so there's a small coverage gap 21:00-23:00 UTC we need to staff next week.

Michael Chen: I can cover 09:00-13:00 and extend to 15:00 if needed. Not available 21:00. Also Priya, you said you have a calendar conflict — want me to pick up the early window?

Priya Patel: Yeah, can we swap the first 4 hours? I need to be in a cross-team sync 02:00-04:00 UTC (can't be primary). Proposal: Michael takes primary 01:00-05:00 UTC, I remain reachable as secondary 01:00-05:00 and then resume primary 05:00-09:00.

Michael Chen: I can do that. I'll take primary 01:00-05:00. I'll add a short note in the runbook and set my on-call status. Low friction swap. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Thanks Michael. I'll update the calendar and rotation doc. Code snippet for the schedule update in case anyone needs it (copy to /schedules/rotation):
```
01:00-05:00 Michael Chen (primary)
01:00-05:00 Priya Patel (secondary)
05:00-09:00 Priya Patel (primary)
09:00-17:00 Michael Chen (primary)
```

oncall-bot: Recorded change: Michael Chen set to primary 01:00-05:00 UTC for today. Priya Patel set to secondary 01:00-05:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Reminder - if you perform any manual failovers, annotate the incident channel and runbook with steps executed.

incident-bot: ALERT -> P2: increased errors on /v1/generate (region-eu). Page sent to current primary: Michael Chen. Paging channels: #incidents, #eng-oncall.

Michael Chen: Got the page. Quick triage - looks like connection spike to pg-prod read replica. Following runbook: /runbooks/pg-connection-spike.md. First actions: drain affected replica, failover if needed, and scale connection pool.

Michael Chen: Running commands now:
```bash
kubectl --context prod get pods -n inference | grep model-server
pscale mysql connect prod --execute "SHOW PROCESSLIST"
```

Sam O'Neill: If you need a hand I can assist with tracing and log aggregation. I've opened a Coralogix query and shared link.

Michael Chen: Thanks. I'm going to temporarily increase connection pool to 500 and restart the read replicas in eu cluster. Noting steps in incident doc.

Priya Patel: If there's customer impact, set impact_level=P2 and notify CS with brief blurb: "Some users in EU may see elevated latencies on generation; mitigation in progress."

Michael Chen: Mitigation looks good, tail latency recovering. I'll stay primary until handoff completes at 05:00. Priya — please confirm you see the updated schedule on your calendar.

Priya Patel: Confirmed, calendar and rotation doc updated. Thanks all for quick swap and triage. Reopen this thread if anything else pops up. :bow:
